datasets.representation: Complete raw-valued cache float32 features before Task-0 scaling; label excluded; -0=+0; canonical NaNs (none observed). Float32 conversion may merge distinct raw-text/float64 inputs.

definitions.train_duplicate_excess: Within each class: N_train minus distinct feature vectors; global row counts distinct vectors across all classes, so global excess need not sum class excess when labels conflict.
definitions.train_duplicate_affected_rows: Rows whose feature vector occurs at least twice in training, including across labels.
definitions.conflict_rows: All rows, including first occurrences, in feature groups with more than one family label across train plus test.
definitions.test_matches_any_train_rows: Test rows equal to any training feature vector, irrespective of labels; repeated test rows all counted.

provenance.cache_split: feature_hash_group; 80/20 deterministic feature-only hashing; not src random stratified splitter

caps.sampler: numpy.default_rng(42000 + split_index*1000 + class_id); sorted exact global row sample

datasets.partition_routing: SplitMix64(FNV1a64(feature words)) modulo bucket count; equality always full feature bytes
